## Problem and outcome

Describe the trigger, previous behavior, and resulting behavior.

## Tracking

Requirement IDs, plan task IDs, bug IDs; optional GitHub issue links.

## Validation

Checks run, results, and remaining live acceptance. Distinguish local, deployed and verified status.

## Operational changes

Manifest/scopes/storage/migrations, quota effects, deployment and rollback implications; or none.

- [ ] Requirements and plan updated where behavior/status changes.
- [ ] Bug register updated for discoveries/fixes.
- [ ] Runtime architecture updated when affected.
- [ ] No credentials or customer payloads included.
